items.title: 67750_Sippie Wallace oral history interview
items.q: So we named that one song, then we had the other side... that's when I made the 'Showgirl Blues.' Oh, you did that, the 'Country Blues,' first?

ctx.x: Uh-huh. So she asked Buddy, do you have any blues? See, the world was going crazy about blues singing. And so my brother stammered a lot, you know. And he said, I got a sister who's coming from Texas. She got something maybe (inaudible). And I played (unintelligible) with them wierd names (unintelligible) I had to play some blues, and I didn't know how to name them but my brother did. So my brother taught me how to make a story, make a song sound like a story. And then after I played a song, (unintelligible) I…
